crop.notes: A 'Sporting Notes' column of four short items; only the third (a one-line notice for Allen's saloon) is about Allen. The others concern Jem Hall sailing for New York, Notre Dame football, and St. Louis football clubs.

ocr.notes: Allen line correct apart from 'ToM'; 'Jem Hall' misread as 'Jem Haw'.

title.suggested: Tom Allen Notice: Free Concerts at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's sporting notes for December 3, 1892 carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, December 3, 1892, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen's saloon was at 619 Market Street, where he advertised himself as retired champion pugilist of the world
Allen's saloon offered a free concert every evening, advertising that only the best singers were engaged

notes: The Allen line reads like a paid reading notice placed among the sporting news, repeated weekly (see 870).
